extracted.intended_audience: applicants, agents, and patent practitioners preparing or prosecuting PCT international-phase applications
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and mandatory requirements for preparing, filing, and processing international applications under the PCT (international phase) including formalities, search/examination procedures, translations, signatures, fees, and procedural responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to file (IA and demand)
rubrics_metrics.description: Conditions for having the right to file an international application (IA) or a Chapter II demand: depends on nationality and residence; corrections of residence/nationality indications; demand considered not submitted if applicant lacks required residence/nationality; refund rules where demand submitted by applicants who did not have the right.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References: rules on corrections (6.036,10.046), conditions for filing and according of international filing date (6.005(i),6.025(i)(a)), 'deemed' common representative and implications (5.048,10.022,11.006). DO may require documents relating to right during national processing (11.018B, Nat. Phase).

rubrics_metrics.name: Residence / nationality indications
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and effects of indicating applicants' residence or nationality in the request/demand; one applicant must be resident or national of a Contracting State for certain filings and demands.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choice of receiving Office because of applicants' residence (5.009). Correction procedures for wrong indications (6.036). Determination and indication rules (5.023,5.024,5.031-5.032). Common representative residency/nationality requirements for certain filings (11.005).

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to practice / qualification of agents
rubrics_metrics.description: Qualification requirements for agents/attorneys to act in the international phase: agents may be appointed if they have the right to practice before the Receiving Office (RO) and/or the ISA/IPEA; sub-agents are subject to same qualifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Governed by national law applied by the Office/organization concerned (11.002). Agent appointment rules for international phase and for ISA/IPEA procedures (10.020,11.002).

rubrics_metrics.name: Signature requirements (applicant/agent/common representative)
rubrics_metrics.description: Who must sign various parts of the IA, request, demand, SIS requests and other documents; lack of signature considered a defect in request/demand and may affect filing/dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signatures on declarations of inventorship and other boxes specified (5.079,6.048,5.088-5.091,8.026,10.031-10.032). Electronic form guidance and fees for signatures (5.099-5.100,5.102,5.101). Seal can be used instead of signature in certain cases (5.091,10.032).

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal requirements for description and other IA elements
rubrics_metrics.description: The description, claims, abstract and other elements of the IA must comply with specified form and content standards (including Annex C standards for sequence listings).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Description must contain required elements and numbering (5.094,5.012). Description must comply with standards in Annex C and related rules for electronic form (5.099-5.104,7.005-7.012,10.063,11.088). Free text and numbering guidance (5.013,5.099,7.012).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence listings — format and accompanying statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Sequence listings must be provided in prescribed formats; a sequence listing furnished to an ISA does not form part of the IA; the listing must be accompanied by a statement that it does not add matter beyond the disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Format acceptance guidance (6.033, Nat. Chaps.). Sequence listing rules and where they apply (5.011,5.084,5.099-5.104,7.005-7.012,10.063,11.088). Statement requirement referenced (7.010). Software and Annex C standards referenced (5.104, Annex C).

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and criteria for unity of invention (single general inventive concept); procedures and protests related to lack of unity during IS/IPE/SIS and time limits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unity defined at 5.114; single general inventive concept references (5.114-5.115,7.015,7.018). Protest must be accompanied by a reasoned statement (7.019). Procedures at ISA/IPEA/SISA (7.015-7.021,8.044-8.046,10.072-10.073). Conditional unity and time limits referenced (11.049,11.058-11.059).

rubrics_metrics.name: International search (IS) requirements and scope
rubrics_metrics.description: What is searched and when an international search is not required (certain subject matter); procedures for earlier searches and top-up searches; IS report formation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search not required for certain subject matter (7.013). Earlier search and top-up search provisions cited (5.016,5.073-5.073D,5.198,7.002A; 10.062A,10.075). International Search Report (ISR) formation and related items (7.023).

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplementary International Search (SIS) — requests and form
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures, fees, forms and content for requesting a Supplementary International Search, including boxed form fields and required supporting documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General rules (8.001-8.005), fee references, boxes (8.013-8.026), documents forming basis (8.023-8.024), check list, signature, notes and fee calculation sheet (8.025-8.028). Defects and restrictions (8.032-8.034; 11.115). Time limit for submitting request referenced (11.110).

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplementary International Search Report (SISR) — form and contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Form, contents and procedures for the SISR, including publication, transmittal and corrections related to priority claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General (8.047). Form and contents (8.049). Recalculation due to priority corrections or withdrawal (8.048; 11.057). Publication and transmittal rules (8.051-8.053).

rubrics_metrics.name: Written opinion(s) and IPEA/ISA written communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and procedural handling of written opinions from ISA or IPEA, including that IPRP (Chapter II) shall not state whether an invention is patentable under national law but should state whether each claim satisfies patentability criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Written opinion defined (10.066). ISA and IPEA written opinion provisions (7.027-7.032; 10.064-10.067). Applicant responses, amendments and multiple opinions (10.061-10.070,11.047). IPRP (Chapter II) content restrictions and expectations (10.075-10.077).

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendments (Article 19 and Article 34) — statements and filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for amendments filed under Article 19 (claims) and Article 34 (with demand), including required accompanying statements, length and identification, and that certain non-complying statements are not published or communicated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statements accompanying Art.19 amendments (9.007,9.008) — length and identification discussed; Art.34 amendments with IPEA (9.011,10.024) and references to manner and purpose of amendments (10.025-10.028). Non-complying statements not published (9.008).

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract and title requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Abstract must be on a separate sheet; abstract must not include alleged value of invention; title of invention length and requirements; teleprinter/translation length considerations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Abstract on separate sheet (5.172); abstract content constraints (5.169). Title requirements and length (5.019). Teleprinter/length and translation notes (5.019,5.169A,9.017).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sheet numbering, margins, and presentation of IA documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for sheet numbering, margins, positioning of drawings, presentation of drawings and other element-specific sheet rules (size, number of sheets per element, replacement sheets).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numbering/margins/drawing positions referenced (5.131-5.135,5.133,5.085,5.129). Omission and replacement sheet rules, and guidance on replacement sheets annexed to IPRP (5.085,9.005,10.076).

rubrics_metrics.name: Transmissions and transmittal of copies (RO to IB/DO/ISA/IPEA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for transmittal of IA copies, priority documents and other papers between ROs, the IB, ISAs, IPEAs and DOs; including grounds for not transmitting (national security).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transmittal of IA to IB by RO for various reasons (6.025), transmittal of search copy to ISA (6.001(v)), transmittal of priority document copy by IB to DOs (5.070,5.070D), RO right not to transmit for national security reasons (6.010).

rubrics_metrics.name: Translations — when required and effects
rubrics_metrics.description: When translations of IA or elements are required for search, preliminary examination, publication or national phase; furnishing translations may give rise to provisional protection; names/addresses in non‑Latin characters must be translated/transliterated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Translation required for IS/IPE/publication/national phase as listed (4.014-4.016,5.013,5.181,6.013-6.023,9.017,3.004). Furnishing translation to DO may give provisional protection (9.024). Translation processing and publication rules (11.113-11.116).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees and schedule of fees (including search / SIS / transmittal fees)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fee rules and calculation: schedule of fees in Rules, search fees, SIS fees, additional fees for lack of search, refund rules for demand submissions without right to file, and transmittal fees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General fee references (5.104,5.184(iii),10.035(ii)). SIS fee and fee calculation sheet (8.028). Additional fees and invitations for lack of search (7.016-7.021,Annex D). Refunds and handling fees in specific situations (10.043).

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits (filing/transmittal/translation/fees/entry into national phase)
rubrics_metrics.description: Various fixed and recalculable time limits for transmittals, furnishing translations, paying fees, requesting SIS, entering national phase, and recalculation where priority claims change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Time limits fixed from date of mailing (5.173,9.004). Specific time limits referenced for national phase entry (5.005, Nat. Phase), translations (4.014-4.016,6.015), IPE fee payments (10.042,10.047), requesting SIS (8.005), recalculation due to priority claim correction (6.040).

rubrics_metrics.name: Withdrawal and revocation procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for withdrawal of demands, designations, elections, IA and priority claims, and revocation of appointment; notification and effect rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General withdrawal rules (11.048-11.061). Revocation of appointment and required formality (11.011-11.014). Withdrawal of designations and elections references (11.050-11.055,11.060-11.061). Effects when IA considered withdrawn and related DO review (6.055-6.056).

rubrics_metrics.name: Third party observations
rubrics_metrics.description: How third party observations are submitted, treatment (including anonymous observations), comments, and the extent to which competent ISAs/IPEAs may take them into account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: How to submit and provisions (11.111-11.114). Anonymous observations allowed (11.112). Availability under PCT (5.055,5.056). Competent Authorities' treatment referenced (11.117).

rubrics_metrics.name: Statements and standardized wording (e.g., Rule 4.17 declarations, statements accompanying amendments)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for statements accompanying amendments and standardized wording in declarations under Rule 4.17; non-complying statements may not be published or communicated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standardized wording reference (5.075-5.078,6.046). Statements accompanying Art.19 amendments (9.007-9.008). Non-complying statement consequences (9.008).

rubrics_metrics.name: IPRP (Chapter I & II) content and limits
rubrics_metrics.description: What the IPRP (Chapter I) and IPRP (Chapter II) should and should not contain: IPRP (Ch. II) shall not state whether the claimed invention is patentable under national law but should indicate whether each claim satisfies patentability criteria; annexes, amendments and translation requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IPRP (Ch II) content expectations and prohibition on national-law patentability statements (10.075-10.077). Annex and amendment transmission rules and possible EO translation requirements (10.078-10.079).

rubrics_metrics.name: Search copy and record copy handling for publication and search
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for the search copy of the IA, IB record copy, and rights of RO not to transmit copies for national security; record copy deadlines affecting IA status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search copy provisions (5.179-5.181,5.197-5.198,6.059). Record copy transmittal to IB and effect of failure (6.057-6.058). RO right not to transmit for national security (6.010).

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical terminology and words in drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements on the use of technical terminology in the IA and words appearing in drawings; limitations on disparaging comments and value claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical terminology requirements (5.176). Words in drawings guidance (5.131). IA may not contain disparaging signs or comments (5.175). Abstracts not to claim alleged value of invention (5.169).

rubrics_metrics.name: Physical requirements for IA (typewritten/typed/printed, spacing, sheet size)
rubrics_metrics.description: IA should generally be typewritten or printed; spacing, margins, sheet size and other physical presentation requirements apply to ensure uniform publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typewritten/printed requirement (5.106,5.177). Spacing and sheet size references (5.106,5.133). IA complying to extent necessary for reasonably uniform publication (6.032(v)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority claim and priority document handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Validity of priority claims and procedures for requesting/transmitting priority document copies, including use of WIPO DAS and consequences if priority documents are not furnished before publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Validity of priority claim (5.060). Priority document transmittal rules (5.070,5.070B-5.070D). WIPO DAS availability and IB retrieval steps (5.070-5.070C). Publication effects if priority documents not furnished (9.023).

rubrics_metrics.name: Obvious mistakes / considered not to have been made or submitted
rubrics_metrics.description: How certain filings or statements may be considered not to have been made/submitted (e.g., corrections, non-complying statements) and the consequences for publication or filing date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References to 'considered not to have been made/submitted' rules (6.012,6.044). Specific examples include publication of priority information considered not made (6.044) and non-complying statements (9.008).
